name: Young Innovators Program
briefDescription: The Young Innovators Program by Mission Youth, J&K aims to foster innovation among youth, empowering them to transform creative ideas into reality.
descriptionMd: The Young Innovators Program, spearheaded by Mission Youth, J&K, is designed to cultivate a spirit of innovation among the young population of Jammu and Kashmir. It goes beyond mere encouragement, actively providing resources and support to empower youth in developing and realizing their creative concepts. The scheme seeks to build a vibrant ecosystem for innovation in the region.
benefitsMd:
- Encouragement for creative ideas among youth
- Empowerment to bring innovative ideas to life
- Support from Mission Youth, J&K to foster innovation
eligibilityMd: - The program is open to youth residing in Jammu and Kashmir.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
